buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder affidavit to be upload regarding their firm not under liquidation or blacklisted in the past by any organisation for any procedural or sale failure. Affidavit issued date not older than one year from bid publis hed date. 2. Bidder must upload Gem contract copy of similar/ related work done to any Govt organisation as perfor mance.

3. Bidder must upload bank solvency certificate (solvency not older than one year from bid published date) . Bank solvency should mention the name, employee code & mobile number of the issuing authority. 4. Bidder should upload a valid OEM authorisation certificate, and the bid number should be mentioned in the OEM authorisation certificate. 5. EMD/BG should be uploaded by the bidder. If EMD/BG not uploaded by the bidder, the bid should be rejected. Mandatory Documents to be Submitted: (a) Valid ISO certificates of the bidder must be uploaded. (b) Valid GST return of the last Financial Year 6. Bidder must upload BOQ and cat specification file (buyer added bid specific ATC) mentioning all product make, company name and all specifications of the product of this bid, duly mentioned bid number, date an d stamp and signature of the firm. 7. Bidder must attend and quote in all items covered in the Bid/ Self declaration for the same must be uplo ded. 8. Certificate by the bidder to be uploaded, regarding items will be executed as per direction of engineer-i n-charge, complete all as specified and directed. 9. Bidder must be Enlisted with MES. Copy of approval copy must be upload for qualify in technical e valuat ion method. 10. Bidder must be upload following documents: (i) ISO Certifications. Following ISO certificates shall be issued by NABCB accredited certification bodies onl y. Certificates from non-accredited agencies shall not be considered valid. (aa) ISO 9001:2015 (ab) ISO 14001:2015 (ac) ISO 45001:2018 (ad) ISO 50001:2018 (ii) must BIFMA Compliance. The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) possess valid international mem bership with BIFMA (Business and Institutional Furniture Manufacturers Association). The OEM’s credentials shall be verifiable on BIFMA’ s official website (iii) AIOTA Registration. Products falling under Seating System Range, Modular Furniture Range, and Office Furniture Range shall be duly registered and listed on AIOTA’s official portal. (iv) IGBC Certification. A valid Indian Green Building Council (IGBC) certificate must be furnished for produc ts claiming green certification. The certificate should correspond to the items offered against the bid. 11. In the Absence of any Certificate/Document/Undertaking as above, the Bidder shall be technically disq ualified. . 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Turnover

OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
